# SafetyCulture

SafetyCulture (formerly iAuditor) is a workplace operations platform that enables teams to conduct digital inspections, manage audits, track issues, schedule tasks, and maintain compliance through mobile and web applications.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/safetyculture/.

## Actions

- **Create Group**: Create a new group.
- **Get Signature Secret**: Retrieve the current webhook signature secret.
- **List Groups**: List all groups in the organization.
- **List Templates**: List templates in the safetyculture account.
- **Regenerate Signature Secret**: Generate a new webhook signature secret.
- **Search Modified Inspections**: Retrieve inspections modified since a given timestamp.
